heroText: Scores at the gaming table. Shared matches with friends. Stats without the noise.
name: Display name
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Do not reuse a password from other services.
emptyLive: No active matches. Start a new game or record one you have already played.
emptyHistory: No matches yet. Your first battle will start the log.
emptyFriends: No friends yet. Send a request using an account ID.
emptyStats: No matches to analyse. Add a guest result or confirm a shared match.
opCountVaries: This team's composition may differ (selections that count as two or as half, ploys instead of operatives) — check the number.
opCountNone: No roster and no known team composition — type the number.
waiting: Result submitted. Waiting for the other player to confirm.
disputedText: There is a disagreement. Reopen the match, fix the scores and submit the result again.
confirmedText: Result confirmed and included in stats.
guestText: Guest record: no confirmation needed; counted only for the owner.
quickText: For a match already played against a guest, local player or registered player.
demo: These catalogs are for practice. They are not official Kill Team rules. Add your own up-to-date set to the database.
trendHint: Monthly, Europe/Moscow. Solid line — VP scored; dashed — VP conceded. Missing months are not interpolated.
deleteWarning: Your account and sessions will be deleted. Opponents keep their results without your name. Backups retain data until their retention period ends.
remoteChange: The other player changed the match. Save your notes separately and refresh the state.
requestFailed: Request failed. Check the connection and try again.
connectionLost: No connection to the server. Check Wi-Fi.
finishHint: After submitting, the other player checks and confirms the result. Until then the match is not counted in stats.
catalogNotice: Approved Ops 2025. Names and descriptions are editorial summaries, not official text. Check full rules and team exceptions via the source links.
sequenceLocalHint: Checkmarks are stored only on this device for this match and reference version. They are not synced and do not block play.
referenceNotVerified: No verified game sequence for this edition.
referenceCached: Showing a saved reference. Check its date.
localStorageUnavailable: The browser blocked local storage; checkmarks will not be saved.
primaryTiming: The preliminary choice in setup is not shown to the opponent. Lock in the primary op as a strategic gambit in the first turning point. It cannot be changed afterwards.
killHint: Count only operatives that count for Kill Op. If an enemy returns, decrease the counter. Kill grade and the final +1 VP for the lead are calculated automatically. Do not add kill VP manually.
tacNotAvailable: No verified Tac Op is available for the selected team.
approvedSetupHint: Each player saves their own: roster, number of operatives for Kill Op (5–14), Tac Op and preliminary primary op. Four turning points. Each category is capped at 6 VP before the bonus.
aspectHint: Blades of Khaine only: enter the number of operatives of each aspect (including the leader). The total must match your roster; Seek & Destroy and the archetype of the largest aspect are available. If left empty, only Seek & Destroy. Leave zeros for other teams.
primary_not_committed: Both players must lock in their primary op in the first turning point.
player_setup_incomplete: Both players must save a Tac Op and the number of operatives for Kill Op (5–14).
tac_archetype_invalid: This Tac Op is not available to the team's archetype.
aspect_counts_invalid: Check the aspect counts: the total must match the roster.
component_cap_exceeded: Maximum 6 VP per category before the bonus.
kills_out_of_range: Check the number of incapacitated enemies and per-turn corrections.
approved_requires_four_turns: Approved Ops requires four turning points.
primary_closed: Primary op selection is already closed.
finish_requires_turn_four: The game ends after four turning points. Switch the current turning point to the fourth after checking all scores.
noRules: Nothing found in the short index. Full rules are available via the source link.
capHint: Score VP only for fulfilled card conditions; a cap does not mean VP are awarded automatically.
invitedBanner: You have been invited to a match. Sign up or sign in and you will go straight to the game. Code:
hotseatHint: Both players keep score on this phone or tablet. The opponent is a guest and needs no account. The result counts only in your stats.
inviteHint: The opponent opens the link or enters the code on their phone — no friendship needed. Each player keeps their own score; the opponent confirms the result.
quickAlt: Already played and know the final score?
inviteCodeText: Tell the opponent the code or send the link. The code is single-use.
shareInviteText: Kill Team match in KILLSTASS, code:
inviteMissing: No active code: it expired or was replaced.
cancelConfirm: Cancel the match? It cannot be started afterwards.
passDeviceHint: The choice is not shown on the shared scoreboard until it is revealed or the match ends.
guestSetupFirst: Save the shared settings first: mission and teams.
guestSetupLegacyHint: This mission has no secret choice: enter the number of operatives and the roster.
hotseatFinishHint: The match will end and lock. No opponent confirmation needed: the result counts only for you.
hotseatShared: Both players keep score on this device.
hotseatText: Single-device match: counted only for the owner, no confirmation needed.
initiativeHint: Mark the winner of the initiative roll — both players see it and it is saved for each turning point.
finalCountHint: Last turning point: check the final scores before finishing the match.
previewNotReady: Not every player has locked in a primary op: without it the bonus is +0.
previewLegend: Kill: “+1” — bonus for more incapacitated enemies. “Prim.” — primary op bonus; the opponent's is hidden until the match ends.
clockHint: The clock is shared by both phones: the server keeps time, so there is no drift.
clockLimitHint: The limit is used only in Countdown mode. When time runs out the game does not stop — overtime is shown.
rollOffWins: wins the roll-off and decides who has the initiative.
diceHint: Tap a die to select it for a re-roll. Rolls are made on this device and are never sent anywhere.
shareLinkHint: The link opens the result without signing in, but only on your local network. A new link replaces the old one; revoking disables it immediately.
shareNotFoundHint: It was revoked, replaced with a new one, or the match was reopened for edits.
feedbackHint: Only the administrator of this server will see the message. Do not include passwords.
feedbackMessage: What to improve or what broke
demoBanner: Demo: everything is stored only in this browser and never reaches the log or stats. Scoring is simplified.
demoScoringNote: Demo: the primary op bonus is half of its VP rounded up (at most 6 counted); rule caps are not checked. In a real match the server scores by the selected rules pack.
demoRegister: Sign up to keep your games
langSaved: The language choice is stored only in this browser.
exportLangNote: Names in CSV/JSON exports are in Russian, as stored in the database.

teamsDisclaimer: Rules text is shown in English as published by the sources. This is unofficial community data (kt-datacards and BSData); check current Games Workshop publications when in doubt. Orange values differ from BSData and may be recognition errors.
teamsEmpty: The server administrator can import current team and operative data with one command in /opt/killstass:
teamsEmptyHint: The script downloads data from GitHub (kt-datacards and BSData) in a throwaway container and stores it in the database. Offline, load a prepared file instead: ./scripts/import-teams.sh teams-bundle.json
noData: The source has no data for this section.
heroPoint1: VP and CP per turning point, clock and dice
heroPoint2: Shared matches by code on your LAN
clockPauseFirst: Pause the clock to change its settings.
concedeHint: The match ends at once with 10–0 to your opponent, whatever the score; your opponent only has to confirm it.
concedeHotseatHint: The match ends at once with 10–0 to the other player, whatever the score, and the result is saved.
concedeOffline: No connection: you can concede once the server is reachable.
cellClosed: No points available in this turning point
killBonusHint: Kill bonus in the final turning point
rostersHint: Build a team list from BSData rules: limits are checked as you go, the roster exports to BattleScribe and can be attached to a match.
rostersNoData: No teams with a roster schema. The server administrator needs to import a team bundle from version 1.8 or newer:
rostersSource: Data comes from BSData catalogues (wh40k-killteam), an unofficial fan project. Check your roster against current rules.
rosterStale: Team data changed since this roster was saved. Review your picks — outdated entries are marked.
rosterExportHint: Text fits the match roster field; .rosz opens in BattleScribe and New Recruit.
rosterExportNote: The BattleScribe file is generated from the stored BSData schema; rare catalogue conditions may be ignored.
rosterDeleteConfirm: Delete this roster? Matches keep their roster text.
rosterIssue_unknown_entry: {name}: entry no longer exists in team data
rosterIssue_equipment: {count} equipment items, usually no more than {max}
rosterIssue_no_schema: No roster schema for this team
rosterConflict: The roster changed in another tab — the latest version was loaded.
trackerEmpty: No operatives yet. Add them one by one — wounds, orders and activations are visible to both players.
trackerEmptyNoRoster: No roster attached: add operatives by hand or pick a roster during match setup.
opWoundsNeeded: No such datacard in the team — enter wounds by hand.
opRemoveConfirm: Remove this operative from the tracker? If it was incapacitated, the opponent's kill is removed too.
tabletopHint: The phone lies between the players: the opponent's half faces them.
atkHint: Pick the weapon (or a universal grenade) and the target from the tracker or datacards — or type a profile; weapon rules are switched with the buttons. Odds are estimated from 20,000 rolls.
atkNote: Covered: Accurate, Balanced, Ceaseless, Relentless, Lethal, Rending, Punishing, Severe, Piercing (Crits), Devastating, Saturate, cover and obscuring. The defender allocates saves for the least damage.
atkMeleeNote: Melee: damage of all successes without parries — the fight itself is interactive.
atkNeedProfile: Enter a weapon profile: attack dice, hit and damage.
ratingsHint: Confirmed matches between you and your friends (and between friends), oldest first: start 1500, K = 32.
ratingsAllHint: Every confirmed match between two registered players, plus hot-seat matches and quick records against local players (they count once finished or saved), oldest first: start 1500, K = 32. Hidden profiles take part in the calculation but are not listed.
localPlayer: Local player (counts in the club rating)
localPlayerHint: A club member without an account: the same name is the same person for everyone. Leave it unticked for a one-off guest.
tournament_added: You were added to a tournament
tHint: A league (round robin) or Swiss rounds for a LAN evening: friends with accounts and guests by name.
tRoundsHint: For Swiss; empty — from the number of players. League: as many rounds as needed for everyone to meet.
tNoFriends: No friends yet — add guests by name.
tDraftHint: Check the players and start the first round.
tFinishConfirm: Finish the tournament? Results can no longer be changed.
tDeleteConfirm: Delete the tournament with all rounds? The matches themselves stay in the log.
tRoundOpenHint: The next round opens when every pairing of the current round has a result.
tStandingsHint: Win 3, draw 1, loss 0; ties: VP scored, VP difference, strength of schedule (SoS), seed. A bye is a win with 0 VP.
tSosHint: Strength of schedule: your opponents' points
adminOnly: This page is for administrators only.
adminGrantHint: Administrator rights are granted on the server:
rosterImportHint: A .ros or .rosz file (up to 700 KB). The team is recognised from the file; unknown entries are skipped, and the roster can be fixed in the editor.
rosterImportTooLarge: The file is larger than 700 KB.
inviteQrHint: Point the opponent's phone camera here.
demoLead: The real KILLSTASS board: Crit/Tac per turning point, Kill from operatives, CP, initiative, tracker, attack calculator and undo. Scoring follows Approved Ops 2025.
demoSettingsHint: The opponent's operative count sets the Kill Op thresholds.
demoFinishHint: The result is counted right here in the browser. Afterwards you can reopen the game or start a new one.
demoInvalid: This action is not available in the demo.
styleguideHint: The interface building blocks, rendered by the same functions as the app. Sample data is invented.
sg_colorsHint: Theme variables; the ◐ switch toggles light and dark.
sg_body: Body text: a Kill Team match journal on the local network.
sg_warning: Warning: this is how important notes look.
sg_emblemsHint: Faction family colours and the first archetype's glyph; without one — the initial. Geometry drawn for KILLSTASS.
sg_printHint: Print version: cards only, no interface, two per row on A4.
rs_have: I have a password reset code
rs_hint: An administrator of the club gives you the code. It works once and for a limited time; after the change all previous sessions are signed out.
ad_resetHint: Hand the code to the player in person: on the sign-in page they choose «I have a password reset code» and set a new password. The code is shown only once.
ad_resetConfirm: Issue a password reset code for «{name}»? A previous unused code stops working.
ad_seasonsHint: The season Elo rating counts confirmed friendly matches between registered players within the season dates. Seasons do not overlap.
ad_deleteConfirm: Delete the season? Matches and results stay, only the season table goes.
ad_achHint: Achievements are awarded automatically after a match is confirmed and after tournaments and game nights. Built-in ones can be edited or switched off, but not deleted.
ad_ruleHint: The threshold is how many are needed: matches, wins, wins in a row, comebacks, wins by 10+ VP, different opponents, different teams, tournament wins or game nights attended.
ad_tvHint: A screen link opens without signing in on the club TV or projector: live scoreboards, the tournament, the next game night and the season top. The link is the access key: delete the screen if it leaks.
ad_tvDeleteConfirm: Delete the screen? Its link stops working.
ad_localsHint: People without an account whom members record matches against (one shared list). Deleting a player keeps the matches with the name, but they leave the club rating.
ad_localDeleteConfirm: Delete the local player «{name}»? The matches stay, but leave the club rating.
sn_none: No seasons yet. Without a season the club-wide rating applies.
sn_noGames: No games in this season yet.
pl_avatarBad: An image is needed (JPEG, PNG, WebP) up to 20 MB.
pl_avatarHint: The picture is cropped to a 256×256 square in the browser; the server only gets a small copy without metadata.
pl_h2hNone: You have not played each other yet.
pl_hidden: Hide my page from other players
pl_hiddenHint: A hidden page is visible only to your friends and administrators; the TV screen and tables show «Player» instead of your name.
push_off: Push notifications are off on the server (an administrator turns them on with ./scripts/push.sh enable).
push_unsupported: This browser does not support push. On iPhone add KILLSTASS to the Home Screen and open it from there.
push_on: Push is on for this device.
push_offDevice: Push is off on this device.
push_denied: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in the site settings.
push_noWorker: Offline mode is not running: a trusted certificate is needed (a domain with Let’s Encrypt or the installed root certificate).
push_hint: Notifications about challenges, your opponent’s moves, result confirmation, game nights and achievements arrive even when the tab is closed.
al_hint: Settings are stored only in this browser.
al_results: Signal when the opponent confirms or disputes the result
al_noVibrate: This device does not support vibration.
off_queueFull: The offline command queue is full. Wait for the connection to the server.
off_rejected: The server rejected queued commands: {n}. The scoreboard shows its state.
off_queued: No connection. Queued commands: {n} — they will be sent automatically.
off_cached: No connection — showing a saved copy.
nt_lead: Schedule a game night, collect «yes / maybe / no» answers with teams and hand out pairs per table.
nt_pairsHint: No pairs yet. Generate them from the «Coming» answers and publish — players get a notification.
nt_pairsWait: The organiser has not published the pairs yet.
nt_clearConfirm: Delete all pairs of this game night?
nt_generateHint: Pairs are made from the season rating among those coming: neighbours in the table play each other, recent rematches are avoided, an odd player gets a bye.
nt_cancelConfirm: Cancel the game night? Attendees get a notification.
nt_feedHint: A personal link for your phone calendar: all club game nights appear there automatically. Do not share it — it works without signing in.
nt_feedOnce: The link is shown only once — copy it now.
map_lead: Killzone map: operatives, objectives, terrain and arrows by frame — deployment and every turning point. A match map is visible to both players and updates live.
map_newHint: A standard killzone is 30″ × 22″. A match map is easier to open with the «Map» button on the scoreboard: on Volkus maps the terrain is set up for you.
map_layoutHint: A terrain preset sets the 30″ × 22″ board, the drop zones and the objective markers. Match operatives nobody has moved yet follow the new drop zones.
map_swap: Player 1 takes the other drop zone
kz_zones: drop zones and territories: red — player 1, blue — player 2
kz_beneath: dashed — a piece partly beneath another
kz_objectives: objective markers: in each territory and the central one
kz_sourceAo: Layout from the Approved Ops 2025 map (Killzone: Volkus), where player 1 is the grey side and player 2 the orange one.
kz_sourceExample: Layout of a map 3 variant from another set of maps (not Approved Ops 2025), taken from a map image; player 1 is the grey side, player 2 the orange one.
map_keys: Map field: arrow keys move the selected token, Delete removes it, Esc clears the selection
map_deleteFrameConfirm: Delete this frame? It becomes a copy of the previous one again.
map_select: Select a token on the map or in the list.
map_noTokens: The map is empty: pick a tool and click on the field.
map_deleteBoardConfirm: Delete the map with all frames?
map_copyHint: The frame is not saved yet: it shows a copy of the previous one. Any change saves it.
map_conflict: Another player just changed the map — the fresh version is loaded.
tv_notFoundHint: The link is outdated or the screen was deleted. Create a new link in Administration → TV screens.
ref_unverifiedHint: Short overview from warhammer-oracle, not checked against the official rules. The exact wording is in the Core Rules.
ref_noRulesHint: The administrator loads them on the server with one command, together with the team data and the search index:
ref_phasesHint: Phase overview from warhammer-oracle (not verified). The detailed order is in the "Game sequence" panel.
ref_disclaimer: Weapon rules are the BSData text. In case of doubt the official Games Workshop text applies.
ref_offline: No connection to the server: searching the saved general rules, missions and Tac Ops.
ref_searchHint: e.g. Lethal, Piercing, Sweep & Clear, Plant Banner
ad_refHint: Updates (with a backup, checks and loading in one transaction) and rollbacks run on the server; weekly via the systemd timer killstass-reference.timer.
rules_hint: Kill Team at hand: a quick search, the whole core rules book and the team rules.
rules_quickHint: Search weapon rules, phases, missions, Tac Ops, teams, ploys and equipment.
rules_coreHint: The whole core rules book: phases and actions, key principles, killzones, missions, appendix.
rules_factionHint: Teams: operatives, faction rules, ploys, equipment and roster selection.
cr_intro: Kill Team (2024): the current core rules — the text of the core book with all the official rules updates applied.
cr_searchHint: For example: obscured, control range, counteract
cr_searchEnHint: Try another term or a shorter query.
cr_source: Source: Warhammer 40,000: Kill Team — Core Book (2024) and the official Core Rules: Update Log (October 2026); the updates are applied in the text. The maps and diagrams of the book are not included.
grp_musterHint: Getting ready for a game: kill team rosters and killzone maps.
grp_resultsHint: Games played and what follows from them: the log, statistics, rating and seasons.
grp_clubHint: The club's people and events: friends and challenges, game nights, tournaments.
sec_rostersHint: Kill team rosters from BattleScribe data: options, operative rules, validation, print.
sec_mapsHint: Killzone maps: terrain, markers, deployment and game frames.
sec_historyHint: All games: results, confirmations, match logs.
sec_statsHint: Statistics by team and mission, Elo rating, seasons.
sec_nightsHint: Club game nights: sign-up, tables and pairings.
sec_tournamentsHint: Swiss tournaments and leagues: rounds and standings.
profileAdminHint: Users, feedback, the reference, seasons, the browser error log.
equipTeamFirst: Select a team and save the setup first — then its equipment appears.
equipNone: The reference has no equipment for this team.
equipHint: Secretly, up to four options, each once. The opponent sees them when the match starts, then each player gains 2CP.
ployHint: A ploy costs 1CP (if its rules say otherwise, correct the CP with ±). Other than Command Re-roll, each ploy is used once per turning point. Uses go to the match protocol; «Undo» returns the CP.
commandRerollText: Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack or defence dice. You can re-roll one of those dice.
ployTeamUnknown: This team's ploys are not in the reference — Command Re-roll is available.
ployRepeatConfirm: This ploy has already been used this turning point. By the core rules each ploy other than Command Re-roll is used once per turning point. Use it again?
cpAfterInitiative: Then the CP of the turning point: +1 for the player with initiative, +2 for the other.
ad_errorsHint: Unhandled JavaScript errors of the members: version, page, message and the start of the stack — no form data or address parameters. A repeat of the same error raises its count; entries are kept for {n} days.
ad_errClearConfirm: Delete all entries of the error log?
recordedConfirmHint: Enter the player’s public ID. They will be notified and can confirm or dispute the result. It is excluded from statistics until confirmed.
recordedDisputed: The result was disputed. The author can cancel it and create a new record with the corrected score.
